items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: I worked with him, you know, but I never was a member of the band. I worked with him. We'd work together, you know, and I'd play in the dance, where they'd have two bands.

ctx.x: That's right, along them kind of circuses.
That's what he's like, a small one, you know. Yeah. And you know Bebe Ridley. Oh, yeah.
